issues.description: THREE-PATCHES: drop 3.9 + DNF migration + stale comment cleanup smashed into one commit
issues.detail: The Amazon Linux / Rocky install scripts were switched from yum to dnf with an added `dnf search python3.12` (which only prints output and isn't a build step) in the same patch that removes 3.9. That belongs in its own commit so a future bisect on install-script breakage lands on the right change. Split it.

issues.description: Stray `dnf search python3.12` left in production install steps
issues.detail: `dnf search` produces human-readable output and has no effect on what gets installed. It's either debug residue from authoring the patch or a misunderstanding of dnf. Either way it pollutes CI logs and signals the patch wasn't cleaned up before submission. Delete it.

issues.description: Dead `default_raise` helper and its stale 3.10 comment left behind
issues.detail: `default_raise` exists explicitly "for < 3.10 compatibility" per its own comment, and `kw_only_dataclass` was its only real consumer. Now that kw_only is unconditional, audit whether `default_raise` is still load-bearing or can be deleted along with the comment that lies about why it exists. Half-finished cleanups rot.

issues.description: GOOD-TASTE: zip(x, x[1:]) replaced with itertools.pairwise
issues.detail: Correct use of the stdlib once 3.9 is gone. Eliminates an off-by-one foot-gun and the intermediate slice. This is the kind of small cleanup that belongs in a 3.10-floor patch. Keep it.

issues.description: PR description contradicts the diff on Union typing
issues.detail: Description says Union "will soon not be supported through Ruff" but the diff doesn't touch a Ruff config or do any Union-to-pipe rewrites. Either land the Ruff rule change in this PR or drop the bullet from the description. Commit-message-vs-diff mismatch wastes the next reader's time.

issues.description: Stale `# pragma: no cover` comment removed without verifying coverage
issues.detail: The conditions.py change drops a comment explaining a 3.9 coverage quirk and the pragma. Fine in principle on a 3.10 floor, but confirm the line is actually covered now on the matrix; otherwise coverage gating silently degrades. Cheap to check, expensive to discover later.

review.summary: Mechanically this is a sound floor-raise: drop 3.9 from CI matrices, installers, and docs, unconditionalize `kw_only=True` dataclasses, swap `zip(x, x[1:])` for `itertools.pairwise`. That part is GOOD-TASTE — special cases for an old interpreter get deleted, not abstracted. The patch loses points for scope: the install-script files quietly migrate Amazon/Rocky from yum to dnf and leave a no-op `dnf search python3.12` in production CI, which is unrelated to dropping 3.9 and should be its own commit. The cleanup is also half-finished — `kw_only_dataclass` is gone but `default_raise` and its \"< 3.10 compatibility\" comment remain, and the PR description promises a Ruff Union change that doesn't appear in the diff. NEEDS-WORK: split the dnf migration out, drop the `dnf search` line, finish the cleanup or remove the misleading comments, and reconcile the description with what actually shipped.
